title: River Walk traffic: two riders with pedal loops, two cars
note: Your redraw calls on the road cars and cyclists (25 Oct). Made at true scale from a blockout with Pepper at 1x, on SpriteCook's own pixel grid (no resizing anywhere), snapped to the River Walk palette, then polished pixel by pixel (every changed pixel listed in art/source/<name>/edits.json). The riders are 1.85 m with the helmet (87 px), the same art on the promenade and in the bike lane; their wheels are drawn by rule, round with 8 even spokes, and turn in the pedal loop. The cars are at the road lane's 55 px a metre. SpriteCook 148 credits.
question: The cars came out a little bigger than my guess (estate 241 x 88 px, hatchback 185 x 77): both are still at or under real car size. Keep, or ask for them smaller? The road's other three cars (taxi, van, car 5) are the old art: redraw them in the same style next?
